details:
Cockpit component for managing libvirt virtual machines.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * cockpit-machines: cockpit-appstream: RHSM access-token disclosure through image helper command-line arguments (CVE-2026-113495)
  * cockpit-machines: cockpit-appstream: VNC console password disclosure through virt-xml command-line arguments (CVE-2026-113496)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
